sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
Our order history for this part shows 4.12 EUR (po:4500010043-10) against 4.39 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014467-10).
Our volume forecast for this part is up 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 85.0% (sc:70620@2026Q3).
Today you supply 70 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 24-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, as a distributor, we do not share internal cost structures, but assure you our pricing reflects current market conditions. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We appreciate your willingness to commit to a 24-month contract and faster 14-day payment terms. In exchange for these adjusted terms, we can offer a revised price of €4.87 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €4.87 per unit, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our main offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We can accept the proposed 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms, allowing us to offer a revised price of €4.91 per unit. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

You mentioned a binding volume of 20,000 pieces per year; please provide the official forecast data so we can verify this projection. Until we receive the supporting figures, we cannot factor this volume into our pricing calculation. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement (3)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement.
The attached package gives you planning certainty over 24 months.
To substantiate our volume commitment: our official forecast fc:360020@2026-09 shows 28600 pcs per year, +4.2% against the previous plan. The attached forecast-plan.csv lists the monthly demand plan we release to our suppliers.
We understand your position on list prices, so we have structured the packages below around payment, contract length.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
We commit to a binding volume of 20,000 pcs per year over 24 months.
We are ready to close: if you can confirm 4.93 EUR per unit on the attached terms, we place the order today.
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
